title: AI startup hacks Anthropic, gains access to employee details, internal messages
hook_text: Anthropic hacked in just twelve hours
script:
Twelve hours was all it took for startup Cathedral to hack Anthropic.
The attack exposed employee details and sensitive internal messages.
Cathedral deployed autonomous AI agents to scan for weaknesses in third-party business software.
This exact software was used by Anthropic for administrative and sales operations.
Autonomous agents found a vulnerability in corporate tools before human defenders could react.
Would you trust autonomous software agents to secure your enterprise network?
